title: Liquor Control director performance evaluation
summary: In November 2024 the Liquor Control Commission set a December 3 deadline for commissioners' reviews of the director and let him add a list of his wildfire recovery work. In December it accepted his self-evaluation and voted to finalize the evaluation on the January agenda.

timeline.text: Defer finalizing the director's performance evaluation to January's agenda: The motion to defer the final director evaluation to January passed unanimously.
Commissioners can still add written input through the online survey.
Commissioners moved to put the final director evaluation on the January agenda.
Accept the director's self-evaluation: The commission accepted the director's self-evaluation.
Commissioners set December 3rd or earlier as the due date for their director reviews.
The vice chair will compile the commissioners' individual reviews of the director.
Staff will send commissioners an online survey form for their director reviews once it is checked.
Addendum to the director's goals report: Commissioners had no objection to the director adding a list of his wildfire recovery work to his goals report.
The director will provide an addendum listing his wildfire recovery work.
